title: Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Moed Katan 15b, speaking in Rav Yosef’s name; but the reading of Dikdukei Soferim is Rav Acha, and likewise there at 15a the statement is attributed to Rav Acha bar Pinchas.[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Moed Katan 15b has Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas speaking in Rav Yosef’s name, while 15a has Rav Acha bar Pinchas. The Dikdukei Soferim reading is retained as Hyman’s report; the different names are not silently merged or emended.
